mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% year-over-year signals inflationary pressure, leading to potential monetary tightening by the Federal Reserve, which in turn may cause negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns remain positive in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL YoY > 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A significant decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates a tightening labor market, which can lead to wage inflation and increased production costs, potentially resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in > 50% of instances where UNRATE decreases significantly.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in housing starts (HOUST) signals a weakening demand in the housing market, which is a leading indicator of broader economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in > 70% of instances where HOUST decreases > 5% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) suggests a strong supply-side response to demand, which can lead to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as companies benefit from increased output and efficiency.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in > 50% of instances where INDPRO increases.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is above 6% and nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase, it signals a recovery in the labor market, which can lead to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as consumer spending is expected to increase.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in > 50% of instances where UNRATE > 6% and PAYEMS increases.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) coupled with a rise in real GDP (GDPC1) indicates accommodative monetary policy supporting economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in > 50% of instances where FEDFUNDS decreases and GDPC1 increases.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in retail sales (RSAFS) coupled with a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) suggests strong consumer demand and a healthy labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS increases > 5% YoY and UNRATE decreases
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where RSAFS increases > 5% YoY and UNRATE decreases.

mechanism_narrative: During a period of economic expansion, an increase in industrial production (INDPRO) above its 12-month moving average signals robust supply-side growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in > 50% of instances where INDPRO > 12-month MA during economic expansion.
